mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a tightening monetary policy or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to wage pressures or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units per month signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1.5 million does not lead to strong consumer demand or if S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO < 100 does not lead to a weakening supply side or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increase does not lead to a tightening monetary policy or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200,000 does not lead to strong labor market conditions or if S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below $500 billion signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS < $500 billion does not lead to weakening consumer demand or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market
failure_condition: If the joint movement of FEDFUNDS and UNRATE does not lead to the described conditions or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.
